crossRefs.note: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translations.web: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.
translations.bsb: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.
translations.kjv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
translations.asv: And he overlaid it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: and he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
